lines.text: Ask Kabir what really happened the night Arjun died.
[weak, smiling] Told you I don't make it. Guess I was wrong.
[laughing through tears] I'd never laughed and cried at the same time before.
[soft] For the first time in seven days, eleven eleven passed... and nothing came.
lines.show: For the first time in seven days, 11:11 passed… and nothing came.

lines.text: [warm] A week of nothing. Coffee. Rain. Him.
[low] Eleven eleven. A new message. In a voice I knew too well.
lines.show: 11:11. A new message. In a voice I knew too well.

lines.text: [calm, older, a little tired] Hey. Don't freak out. It's me... you. Ten years from now.
[quiet, serious] Ask Kabir what really happened the night Arjun died. He wasn't at home.
